timeline.text_cn: 最低生命值阈值从20%提高至40%。
被影响的盟友获得的治疗量提高25%。
持续时间从10秒缩短至6秒。
现在当巴蒂斯特位于空中时为“生物手雷”提供追踪能力。追踪力度会随着“动力战靴”充能程度提升。

timeline.text_en: Minimum health threshold increased from 20% to 40%.
Now applies homing to Biotic Grenades while Baptiste is airborne. Homing strength scales with Exo-Boots charge.

timeline.text_cn: 冷却时间从14秒缩短至12秒。

timeline.text_en: Healing over time increased from 40 to 50.
Air-dashes are used by jumping in mid-air, launching Baptiste horizontally in the direction he is moving.
Air dash charges do not decay over time.

timeline.text_cn: 可蓄力最多4次空中疾冲。
在空中跳跃即可使用空中疾冲，会使巴蒂斯特向当前的移动方向冲去。
空中疾冲不会随时间衰减。

lines_en: Healing per shot increased from 25 to 40.

timeline.text_cn: 冷却时间从25秒缩短至22秒。

lines_cn: 不再移除“愈合冲击”的治疗。
攻击速度加成从30%降低至25%。

lines_en: No longer removes healing from Regenerative Burst.
Attack speed bonus reduced from 30% to 25%.

lines_cn: 主要攻击模式的三连发全部命中会装填一发治疗榴弹。治疗榴弹直接命中会装填3发主要攻击模式弹药。
现在使用任意技能会触发巴蒂斯特的“肩负炮台”，周期性对盟友发射最多3发治疗弹，每发恢复25点生命值。

lines_en: Hitting an entire three-round burst reloads a healing projectile. Healing projectile direct hits reloads 3 primary fire ammo.
Changed to now using any ability triggers Baptiste's Shoulder Turret, periodically firing up to 3 shots at allies, each restoring 25 health.

timeline.text_cn: 直接击中治疗量从20提高至30。
现在会进行瞬间治疗，但不会对生命值较低的目标提供大幅治疗。

timeline.text_en: Direct impact healing increased from 20 to 30.
Will now do instant healing but cannot critically heal low targets.

timeline.patch_title: Totally Normal Patch Notes for Totally Normalwatch – April 1, 2025
timeline.text_en: Press Crouch while airborne to stomp on enemies.

timeline.patch_title: 完全正常的“完全正常先锋”补丁说明——2025年4月1日
timeline.text_cn: 在空中时按“蹲下”键可以踩踏敌人。
每次射击治疗量从25提高至30。

timeline.text_en: Healing per shot is increased from 25 to 30.

timeline.patch_title: Overwatch 2 Retail Patch Notes + Hero Perks - February 18, 2025
timeline.text_en: Immortality Field restores 80 health to nearby allies and 40 health to Baptiste when destroyed.

timeline.patch_title: Overwatch 2 Retail Patch Notes + Hero Perks - February 18, 2025
timeline.text_en: After placing Amplification Matrix, your Shoulder Turret periodically fires up to 12 shots at allies, each restoring 25 health.

timeline.patch_title: Overwatch 2 Retail Patch Notes + Hero Perks - February 18, 2025
timeline.text_en: Regenerative Burst grants Baptiste 20% attack speed for 4 seconds, but no longer instantly heals.

timeline.patch_title: Overwatch 2 Retail Patch Notes + Hero Perks - February 18, 2025
timeline.text_en: While airborne from Exo Boots, use Jump to dash horizontally.
No longer heals twice as much for allies under 50% max health.
Healing over time increased from 40 to 100 over 5 seconds.

timeline.patch_title: Overwatch 2 Really, Really, Really Balanced Patch Notes - April 1, 2024
timeline.text_en: Now launches you forward rather than upward.

timeline.patch_title: Overwatch 2 Really, Really, Really Balanced Patch Notes - April 1, 2024
timeline.text_en: Increases speed of projectiles shot through it by 200%.
Minimum health threshold decreased from 25% to 20%.
Primary fire ammo reduced from 45 to 36.
Heal over time decreased from 50 over 5 seconds to 40 over 4 seconds.
Automatic Reload setting now reloads when both Primary and Secondary Fire are out of ammo if setting is set to Off
Default Amplification Matrix Rotation - Horizontal by default
Amplification Matrix Confirmation Input - Primary Fire by default
Immortality Field minimum health threshold increased from 10 to 25%
Charge time increased from 0.7 to 1 second
Healing projectile explosion reduced from 60 to 50 health
Healing projectile direct impact now restores an additional 20 health
Now protects teammates to a minimum health threshold of 10% maximum health, down from 20%
Width increased from 5 meters to 9 meters
Recovery time reduced from 0.45 to 0.38 seconds
Baptiste now receives twice as much healing from Regenerative Burst
Charge time reduced from 1 to 0.7 seconds
